restatement: Add a Replay page that plays a pick's Decision log back one event at a time so Boyd can scrub Pick 4 and see elapsed time, status, stage, runs, and what just happened.

acceptance.when: the Replay route opens for a fixture pick
acceptance.shall: show the Replay DOM at frame 1 equal to frameAt(timeline, 0)
open at that frame or start playing per the playback rules
advance one frame per 1000 ms and stop on the last frame

acceptance.when: a hostile pick body is stepped through
acceptance.shall: keep server text as text and never draw an href outside links[]

acceptance.when: the Replay page is probed at phone and desktop widths
acceptance.shall: print ok:true with controls at least 44x44 at every width

acceptance.when: npm test runs after this change
acceptance.shall: still pass every earlier suite with guards byte-identical

rubric.name: Frame fidelity on real logs
rubric.howToGrade: Run pooled R1-R4 against the five fixtures through frameAt(). 4 = every frame equals frameAt(). 2 = one wrong run state. 0 = browser formats a duration. Evidence: node --test test/replay.pooled.test.ts or file:line.

rubric.name: Playback discipline
rubric.howToGrade: Drive R5-R8 with the fake clock. 4 = one timer, focus preserved, leave stops play. 1 = two timers or a timer after leaving. Evidence: test/replay.test.ts:R5-R8.

rubric.name: Game-film screens
rubric.howToGrade: Run cdp-shot.mjs on ?at=1,11,20 at 390/430/1280 light and dark. 4 = every probe ok:true and a stranger can read the film in 5 seconds. 0 = sideways scroll or a control under 44x44 at 1280. Screenshots required for 3 or 4.

rubric.name: Same-origin, text-only safety
rubric.howToGrade: Re-run the safety-fact proof with hostile titles and javascript: agent ids. Grep replay.js for innerHTML and localStorage. Any markup or off-origin request = 0. Evidence: test/replay.test.ts:R14. Score 0-4.

rubric.name: Harness-backed tests
rubric.howToGrade: test/replay.test.ts drives replay-harness.mjs. Expected values come from frameAt() and the spec literals. Break one rule by hand and a candidate test must fail. Score 0-4.

rubric.name: Clean stack, small diff
rubric.howToGrade: git diff --name-only START...HEAD stays inside the touch map. One files line in http.ts. Zero runtime deps. Compare diff.added+removed. Score 0-4 with evidence from git diff --shortstat.

designSketch: Boyd taps Replay on Pick 4, scrubs to Event 11, sees +2h 53m JUDGING Film Room, then presses Play.
verifyPlan: prove the safety fact through the harness
safetyFact: No pick body can make Replay request anything but one same-origin GET /api/picks/<id> per open or live update, render server text as markup, or store anything.
angles: Frame engine: start from the frame rule; one pure function maps (timeline, index) to a frame; one playback record; one paint; smallest app.js hunks.
Broadcast booth: start from the demo video; scoreboard, lower-third caption, field of runs at 1280, thumb-reach control bar on phone.
Chapter cuts: start from the story; stage chapter nav jumps to each stage's first event; VoiceOver order is film, controls, chapters, lists.
